field.name: project_id
field.label: COM_JOOMLEAGUE_FIELD_PROJECT_LABEL
field.query: SELECT id AS value, name AS text FROM #__joomleague_project WHERE published = 1 ORDER BY name

field.name: entry_id
field.label: COM_JOOMLEAGUE_PARTICIPANTSTATS_ENTRY_LABEL
field.query: SELECT id AS value, COALESCE(NULLIF(display_name, ''), entry_code, CONCAT('ID ', id)) AS text FROM #__joomleague_project_entry WHERE published = 1 ORDER BY display_name, id
